steps: Fresh incognito /studio-lab at 1280x720, Decline consent, wait for the library to settle
Focus the Middle East library row and press Enter twice (2 clips on the music lane, back to back), then click Fit
Real mouse: press on the second clip's title strip (y = top + 7), move left onto the first clip in 60 steps, then hold still at the blocked spot with 1 px wiggles (20 moves), release
A MutationObserver on [data-testid=arrangement-status] counts added element nodes; a capture pointermove listener counts moves
bugs.expected: A blocked move shows the blocked sentence once (or once per change). Repeating the identical sentence on every pointermove should not re-render and should not re-announce it in the polite live region (this was true at 3b6178b, where identical useState text bailed out)
bugs.actual: 81 pointermoves gave 81 added <span> nodes: the identical sentence 'გადატანა დაბლოკილია — მეზობელი კლიპი ან დროის დასაწყისი. კლიპი ბოლო თავისუფალ ადგილას დარჩა.' was inserted 80 times, plus 1 final 'კლიპის გადატანა: ცვლილება არ მოხდა — ისტორია არ შეიცვალა.' Every insertion is a new polite announcement of the same sentence. No longtask, no error. The fade-in clamp shows the same pattern (21 identical 'Fade In: 101.352 წმ' spans while held at the clamp). This is within SR-DRAG-STREAM's bound (added <= pointermoves + 2), so it does not fail an acceptance row. It is new behaviour since 3b6178b. The baseline comparison is an inference from the unit fail-before (an identical setStatus makes 0 DOM records at baseline); C did not run a baseline dev server.
bugs.evidence: c-round-104/out/blocked-1280x720.json, c-round-104/out/drag-1280x720.json, c-round-104/shots/sr-blocked-1280x720.png; source ArrangementClip.tsx l.495, 513, 563, 579-581 (setStatus(message) on every move); A report a-round-104.md 'Known gaps'; doc 092 l.60

notPassed.status: criterion not met as written (spec mismatch, not an A regression)
notPassed.detail: The run did Middle East + Enter, Space, Space. The <output> stayed the same node with exactly one element child at all 6 samples. replaced=0. The transport advanced from 00:00.362 to 00:01.062 while playing and stopped at 00:01.070 after pause. But Space (play) and Space (pause) set no status at 3b6178b (togglePlayback only sets status for an empty project or play past the end), so only 2 distinct texts appeared, not 3. The intent (region stable across distinct texts) is covered by SR-TEXT-REG: 4 distinct texts, the same node and 1 child each time. B should rewrite the row. Note: 'passed' holds 11 of the 12 acceptance IDs (SR-REPEAT-SPACE counted per viewport); SR-REGION-STABLE is the 12th and is excluded for the reason above. pausePlaybackWithStatus(message) exists but is only called by consumers with their own message, not by Space.
